_about: The six base acts of Rulebook in Motion, read from CELLAR (metadata through the SPARQL endpoint, texts through content negotiation) and from EUR-Lex document pages on 2026-09-30. Status history: adopted on the date of the act, applies-from on entry into force while application waits, in-force once the general date of application has passed. The applies list gives each date of application with the sentence that sets it. Related acts are the amending, delegated and implementing acts CELLAR links to each base act; corrigenda, consolidated versions and proposals are left out.
